content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(Type.annotation(list-partial(@F, @G), Analysis.PFun), Type.annotation(list-partial(@x, @L), Real), Analysis.funLim(F, @y, x, L), Logic.exists-typed(@delta, Real, Logic.and($#0 > 0$(delta), Logic.and(Set.subset(Analysis.nbhDel(x, delta), Analysis.domain(G)), Logic.forall-typed(@y, Real, Logic.implies(Set.mem(y, Analysis.nbhDel(x, delta)), Eq(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), y), Type.apply(Analysis.map(G), y)))))))), Analysis.funLim(G, @y, x, L))

values.en:
If `F` tends to `L` at `x₀` and `G` agrees with `F` on some punctured neighbourhood of `x₀` (and that neighbourhood lies in `G`'s domain), then `G` tends to `L` at `x₀` as well. For sequences the corresponding statement is agreement beyond some index.

This is the precise sense in which a limit sees only germ-level data. It is also the workhorse lemma for rewriting under a limit, since it lets an algebraic simplification valid near `x₀` — but not at `x₀` — be applied.
values.zh-CN:
若 `F` 趋于 `L` 于 `x₀`，且 `G` 与 `F` 在 `x₀` 的某个去心邻域上相等（并且该邻域包含于 `G` 的定义域），则 `G` 也趋于 `L` 于 `x₀`。对数列而言，相应陈述是从某个指标之后二者相等。

这精确说明了极限只取决于芽层面的数据。它也是在极限号下进行改写的核心引理，因为它允许应用在 `x₀` 附近成立、但在 `x₀` 处不成立的代数化简。
